title: He Xiangning Art Museum
scope: The standing He Xiangning Art Museum building at 9013 Shennan Boulevard, including the light panel cladding, projecting glazed gallery and adjacent elevated entrance walk.
limitations: The two attached mapped volumes and museum approach. Neighboring museums, road features and advertisements are outside scope.
Unpublished vertical dimensions, structure of the pedestrian walk and rear façade openings are estimated.
